questions.q: Where does an admin add or configure a related list on a Lightning Record Page?
options: Lightning App Builder, as a draggable component pointed at a related object
Object Manager → Validation Rules
Setup → Profiles → Related List Access
The Report Builder's field selector
questions.explain: A related list is a component in Lightning App Builder, placed on the record page and pointed at a specific related object, with its own settings panel.

questions.q: What does a standard (non-dynamic) related list display?
options: Only records matching a saved filter
Nothing until an admin manually refreshes it
Only the five most recently modified related records
Every related record, in whatever columns were configured, with no filtering of its own
questions.explain: A standard related list renders a fixed table of every related record in the configured columns — it has no filtering capability of its own.

questions.q: What does upgrading to a Dynamic Related List add on top of a standard related list?
options: Nothing — Dynamic Related Lists look identical to standard ones
Its own label, column selection, sort field/order, record limit, and filters
The ability to edit related records inline, which standard related lists cannot do
Automatic translation of column headers into the user's language
questions.explain: A Dynamic Related List adds real configuration — its own label, fields, sort, number of records to display, and critically, filters — none of which a standard related list offers.

questions.q: Why can two Dynamic Related Lists pointed at the same related object, on the same record page, show two completely different sets of records?
options: They can't — related lists on the same object always show identical data
Because one is for System Administrators and the other is for Standard Users
Because each Dynamic Related List has its own independent filters, so one can show only open Opportunities while another on the same page shows only closed ones
Because Dynamic Related Lists refresh on a random schedule
questions.explain: Filters are configured per Dynamic Related List, not per object — so two lists on the same page, pointed at the same object, can be filtered to show entirely different slices of the data.

questions.q: What practical problem does filtering a related list (e.g. to Stage is not Closed) solve directly on the record page?
options: It prevents a busy record's related list from burying the few records a user actually needs among many irrelevant ones, without requiring a separate report
It speeds up page load times by caching records
It automatically emails the record owner when a related record changes
It converts the related list into a chart
questions.explain: The lesson's example is an Account with 40 closed-lost Opportunities burying the 3 open ones a rep needs — filtering the related list surfaces just the relevant slice, directly on the page, with no separate report required.
